description: The Environment Protection Authority publishes a spatial inventory of collection depots used by South Australia’s container deposit scheme. The provider describes a network extending across metropolitan and regional areas. These are beverage-container collection facilities. The asset locations can provide facility inputs for waste collection capacity and access studies. Throughput, service capacity and opening hours are not established by the catalogue metadata. Data.SA lists Shapefile, GeoJSON and compressed KML distributions under CC BY 4.0, with public access. Only catalogue metadata and file headers were inspected. Spatial resolution, attribute definitions and observation currency remain unverified. The Data.SA catalogue record provides the discovery context.
